headline: Turnover Shifts as Contested Fronts Hold
war_summary: Since the previous edition, WeatheredExpanseHex has become the liveliest immediate turnover front, adding two events in the latest two hours and reaching 35 in the day; its bases remain evenly divided at four Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral. FishermansRowHex has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window, but its 25 daily events still mark it as an unsettled sector, with all nine bases currently Colonial-held. StlicanShelf likewise records no fresh two-hour movement, though its daily count has risen to 32 and the map remains divided eight Warden to one Colonial. Stonecradle shows two events in six hours and 12 in the day, with five Warden and four Colonial bases amid accelerating casualty and enlistment rates. DeadLands retains six daily events, including repeated action at Callahan's Gate, but its casualty and enlistment pace is cooling. LinnMercy has eight daily events and sharply accelerating recent casualty rates, while MooringCounty and CallahansPassage continue to post the war's heaviest active fighting without fresh recorded base flips. No victor is declared.
